health.title: CDPH licensed hospitals with emergency services
health.note: Open licensed status is a dated directory attribute, not current operating capacity, emergency entrance or disaster shelter designation.

food.title: CDSS food-bank addresses / Cal OES approximate points
food.note: Address-matched subset only. CDSS does not publish an update date here. Food-bank offices are not necessarily food distribution sites.

boundary.title: CDTFA approximate city taxing boundaries
boundary.note: Generalized by 0.00035 degrees, about 30–40 metres. Not a legal boundary or evacuation line. County boundaries use the existing Census BAS 2026 projection.

tsunami.title: CGS / Cal OES tsunami hazard areas
tsunami.note: Service data edit date, not the publication date of every county map. Generalized by 0.00005 degrees, about 4–6 metres. Planning areas, not a current warning, route, safe-zone designation or predicted inundation for a particular event.

shelters.title: FEMA open shelters
shelters.note: Queried on demand for the chosen map area. All incidents, not necessarily earthquake-related. Missing or empty data cannot establish that no local shelters exist.

dcmh-meals.title: Davis Community Meals: meals program
dcmh-meals.note: Provider address and service checked. Publisher date not supplied. Approximate point: US Census Public_AR_Current geocoder, checked November 2, 2026.

dcmh-center.title: Davis Community Meals: resource center
dcmh-center.note: Provider address and service checked. Publisher date not supplied. Approximate point: US Census Public_AR_Current geocoder, checked November 2, 2026.

buildings.title: Microsoft estimated building footprints, hosted by Esri
buildings.note: Computer-generated outlines; source imagery dates are not supplied by this layer. The service data edit date is April 13, 2022. A highlight means the outline contains a directory point; it does not verify the building, entrance, accessibility, structural safety or current service. Unmatched and ambiguous locations keep pins. Extracted geometry is © Microsoft, ODbL 1.0.
